Code updates & expired codes

Source review · October 18, 2026

We have not verified a fixed new-code schedule. A game update or event is not proof that a new code will be released.

Where to check for announcements

  • Official Roblox experience: check that you are following the correct game and creator.
  • Huss Valley Official community: the creator linked from the official game page.
  • Huss Valley Official Discord invite: IGN identifies this as the code announcement source. We verified the public invite title, but did not access announcement history behind sign-in.
  • IGN code guide: our current secondary source for the reported code strings, rewards and redemption route.

Before trusting a repost, look for the original message, its publication date, spelling, conditions and any expiry. We cannot give an exact next release time from the evidence available. A weekday in a code's name is not a release calendar.

Latest evidence review

Review dateWhat we could confirm
October 18, 2026IGN lists TUESDAYSROCK, FIRSTCODEEVER and HUSS4CODE, and reports no expired entries. Our redemption tests are pending. The Roblox creator link and public Discord invite were reviewed.

This records a source review, not a promise of daily updates or a successful code redemption. See each code and its status.

Expired code archive

No confirmed expired entries in our archive yet. That means we lack evidence to label an entry expired; it does not mean every reported code still works. IGN's page reported no expired codes when reviewed.

When an expiry is established, the record will retain the code, reported reward, evidence link and expiry date if known. If the original expiry date is unknown, we will state “Unknown” and record when the failure was confirmed. Archived records will not be deleted to make the list look newer.

Help keep the record accurate

Report an expired code or a new announcement with the original public source. A screenshot without a source URL or a copied list without attribution is not enough for us to claim an official release. For a failed attempt, include the exact error and test date.

Need to use an existing code? Read the redemption steps or troubleshoot the message you received.

We do not guarantee that every code will work. Codes are issued by the developer and are available only while supplies or the offer last.

Sources: IGN redemption guide and code list (reviewed October 18, 2026), official Roblox experience, and developer community. Source review is not an in-game redemption test.

Where each claim comes from

Public-source review: 2026-10-18. Roblox APIs, the public Discord invite and IGN were fetched on October 18, 2026. No in-game redemption test was performed. Each entry below separates what we could read from what remains unverified.

Official Roblox experience Primary source · observed 2026-10-18 · Public API rechecked

Official API identifies Huss Valley Official, place 107535308163741 and universe 10764627709. The display name carries a Halloween marker. Description: RUN!!. Last updated 2026-10-18 UTC.

What this does not prove: A game-update date is not a code-release date. The public description does not establish whether codes were announced elsewhere.

Developer community Primary source · observed 2026-10-18 · Public API rechecked

The Roblox community API returns Huss Valley Official, description Playing tag in huss valley, and no public shout.

What this does not prove: This is a snapshot of the public area, not access to private messages or a complete announcement history.

Huss Valley Official Discord invite Public invite source · observed 2026-10-18 · Public invite API rechecked; messages inaccessible

The invite API identifies Huss Valley Official | Roblox. Announcement history was not fetched.

What this does not prove: Announcement history was not read. The invite title alone does not verify any code or its expiry.

IGN Huss Valley guide Secondary source · observed 2026-10-18 · Full public article rechecked

Article updated October 16 lists the same three codes and rewards. Redemption route is Menu > Codes > Enter Code. No expired codes are listed.

What this does not prove: Full article fetched October 18; its last published update is October 16. A publisher working-code label does not establish a redemption test by Huss Valley Hub.

Roblox game API Primary source · observed 2026-10-18 · Public API rechecked

Server capacity 30; avatar type MorphToR15; private server creation disabled. Counters are a dated snapshot.

What this does not prove: API fields do not establish live controls, ability effects or redemption success.

Still unknown

  • No official Trello board was verified in the retained research.
  • No Reddit community was established as an authoritative source for this experience.
  • No public redemption-validation API was verified.
  • Boost stacking, activation rules, redemption quotas and region eligibility have not been established.

We do not fill these gaps with a similarly named game's wiki, a guessed Trello board or an unverified social account.
